tagline.zh-CN: 0-18 岁分龄养育，身体、心理、财商三条线，数据只在你手机里
tagline.en: Age-staged parenting for 0-18: body, mind and money sense, with all data kept on your phone

description.zh-CN: 养好娃是给 0-18 岁孩子家长用的本地化家庭教育与成长陪伴工具。按孩子的年龄段给出身体健康、心理成长、财商人格三条线的记录与指导，闭环是建档、分龄内容与记录、阶段报告、AI 探讨。没有账号、没有服务器，所有家庭数据只存在你自己的手机里；AI 能力由你自带大模型 Key，发送前可预览。基础功能免费，进阶能力 Pro 一次买断、永久可用。
description.en: Grow Together is a local-first parenting companion for parents of children aged 0 to 18. It tracks and guides three threads by age band: physical health, emotional growth and money sense, closing the loop from profile to age-staged content and logs, stage reports and AI discussion. No account, no server: every family record stays on your own phone, and AI runs on a model key you bring, with a preview before anything is sent. Core features are free; Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks everything for life.

name.zh-CN: 按年龄段展开的三条主线
name.en: Three threads that unfold by age band

summary.zh-CN: 建档后，身体健康、心理成长、财商人格三条线的内容和面板按孩子当前年龄段出现，一岁不会看到零花钱，青春期不会看到刷牙打卡。
summary.en: After you add a child, the health, emotional-growth and money-sense content appears for their current age band: no pocket money at age one, no brushing check-ins for a teenager.

detail.zh-CN: 内容包按 0-1、1-3、3-6、6-12、12-18 分段，每段有主线任务、阶段主题和该段该看的面板。年龄门控由一张阶段表统一决定，页面不各自判断，所以孩子过生日进入新阶段时整个 App 一起换面板。内容依据国内儿科与发展心理学标准整理，条目注明来源。
detail.en: Content is organised into 0-1, 1-3, 3-6, 6-12 and 12-18 bands, each with main tasks, a stage theme and the panels that belong to that stage. One stage map gates everything, so when a child crosses into a new band the whole app changes together. Content is compiled from Chinese paediatric and developmental-psychology standards, with sources noted.

name.zh-CN: 今天记一笔：顺手记，不是打卡任务
name.en: Log today in one tap, not as a chore

summary.zh-CN: 户外时长、娱乐屏幕、亲子任务、刷牙、今日情绪，首页一张卡点一下就记上；身高体重、花销、日常提醒、心愿目标各有一步到表单的入口。
summary.en: Time outdoors, screen time, the family activity, brushing and today's mood are one tap on the home card; height, expenses, reminders and wish goals each open a form in a single step.

detail.zh-CN: 记一笔记的是今天真的会变的几件事，所以没有完成度和连续天数的压力。每一项都能立刻改回来，一键落库不弹确认框。记录喂给成长页的今日速览、阶段报告和模拟器的对照点，记得越多这些地方越像你家。
detail.en: The card only tracks what actually changes day to day, so there is no completion pressure. Every entry can be undone in place and saves without a confirmation dialog. Logs feed the growth overview, stage reports and the simulator's reference dots, so the app looks more like your family the more you log.

summary.zh-CN: 六个教养滑块拖一下，九维性格雷达同帧变化。起点按你做过的教养方式测评预填，雷达旁叠一组「家里在练什么」的对照点。
summary.en: Drag six parenting sliders and a nine-axis personality radar updates in the same frame. Sliders start from your own parenting-style quiz, and a set of "what the family practises" dots from your logs sits beside the radar.

detail.zh-CN: 模型是基于发展心理学研究的趋势模拟，纯本地线性加权，不是对某个孩子的预测，页面标注了这一点。对照点只在某个维度有三条以上记录时出现，反映的是家长的投入，不给孩子打分，页面上不出现任何分数。可以保存多套方案对比，也可以一键让问问点评当前方案。
detail.en: The model is a trend simulation grounded in developmental-psychology research, computed locally with linear weights; it is not a prediction for any individual child, and the page says so. Reference dots appear only where a dimension has at least three data points, describe the parents' effort rather than grading the child, and no score is ever shown. You can save setups to compare, or ask the in-app assistant to comment on the current one.

name.zh-CN: 问问：用你自己的 AI Key
name.en: Wenwen: AI on your own key

summary.zh-CN: 陪在页面角落的小家伙叫问问。它会主动问今天心情、提醒到点，也能和你探讨一个养育问题。模型由你自己配 Key，发送内容先看再发。
summary.en: Wenwen is the small companion in the corner. It asks about today's mood, surfaces reminders and discusses parenting questions with you. You configure the model key, and you preview what is sent before it goes.

detail.zh-CN: 这是 App 唯一的联网行为。默认只发年龄段和你授权范围内的趋势摘要，不发姓名、生日和健康明细；财商数据默认不发。每一类数据都有单独开关，请求前有取数说明卡列出实际注入的每一条。国内渠道若无算法备案，AI 入口在渠道层整体关闭。
detail.en: This is the app's only network activity. By default it sends the age band plus trend summaries within the scopes you allow; never names, birthdays or health details, and money data is off by default. Each scope has its own switch, and a card lists every item actually injected before the request. In regions requiring algorithm registration, the AI entry is disabled at the channel level.

summary.zh-CN: 疫苗按生日推算下一针，喝水、用药到点准时响，护眼、早睡、每日赞美等挑战可以并行，全家一起坚持。
summary.en: Vaccines are scheduled from the birthday, water and medicine reminders ring on time, and challenges like eye care, early bedtime and daily praise can run side by side for the whole family.

detail.zh-CN: 提醒全部是本机排期，没有推送服务器。喝水和用药走精确闹钟，其余按天提醒；点通知直接落到对应面板。挑战打卡不是一个勾，而是一份该年龄段的达标清单，勾够才算今天完成。
detail.en: All reminders are scheduled on the device; there is no push server. Water and medicine use exact alarms, the rest ring by the day, and tapping a notification lands on the matching panel. Checking in on a challenge means ticking an age-appropriate checklist, not a single box.

name.zh-CN: 数据是你的：本机、备份、可携带
name.en: Your data: on-device, backed up, portable

summary.zh-CN: 没有账号和服务器。每天自动存一份本机快照；导出加密备份文件；iOS 可放进你自己的 iCloud；换机时合并导入，不重复建档。
summary.en: No account, no server. A local snapshot is saved daily; export encrypted backup files; on iOS keep a copy in your own iCloud; merge on import so a child is never duplicated.

detail.zh-CN: 备份文件是你能看懂的 JSON，加密版用口令保护。导入支持合并与覆盖两种模式，合并按孩子姓名加生日认同一个人，预估数字与实际写入是同一段代码算的；覆盖前自动存快照，24 小时内可一键撤销。AI 对话和最私密的自我关怀记录永不进导出文件。
detail.en: Backups are readable JSON, optionally passphrase-encrypted. Import offers merge or overwrite; merge matches a child by name plus birthday, and the preview counts come from the same code that writes. A snapshot is taken before any overwrite and can be undone within 24 hours. AI conversations and the most private self-care notes never enter an export.

a.zh-CN: 一款给 0-18 岁孩子家长用的本地化家庭教育与成长陪伴 App。围绕身体健康、心理成长、财商人格三条线，按孩子年龄段给出记录与指导，闭环是建档、分龄内容与记录、阶段报告、AI 探讨。iOS 和 Android 都有。
a.en: A local-first parenting companion for parents of children aged 0 to 18. It follows three threads, physical health, emotional growth and money sense, by age band, from profile to age-staged content and logs, stage reports and AI discussion. Available on iOS and Android.

a.zh-CN: 没有账号，也没有我们的服务器。所有记录存在你手机的本地数据库里，App 不含任何统计或广告 SDK。唯一会联网的是你自己配置 Key 的 AI 调用，默认只发年龄段和趋势摘要，发送前有一张卡列出每一条要发的内容。备份文件由你自己保管，加密版用口令保护。
a.en: There is no account and no server of ours. Every record lives in a local database on your phone, and the app contains no analytics or ad SDK. The only network call is the AI request made with your own key, which by default sends the age band and trend summaries, with a card listing each item before it goes. Backup files are yours to keep, optionally passphrase-encrypted.

q.en: Is it paid? How does pricing work?

a.zh-CN: 下载免费，建档、分龄内容、记一笔、提醒这些基础能力都能用。进阶能力由 Pro 一次买断解锁，永久可用，没有订阅、没有广告。另有按主题的专家技能包，小额单独买断，装上后问问在对应话题上更在行；技能包不含在 Pro 里，也不含模型费用。具体价格以你所在地区的商店页为准，换机后在付费页点「恢复购买」即可取回权益。
a.en: The download is free and the basics work: profiles, age-staged content, one-tap logging and reminders. Advanced features are unlocked by Pro, a one-time purchase that lasts for life, with no subscription and no ads. Topic skill packs are small separate one-time purchases that make the assistant sharper on that topic; they are not part of Pro and do not include model costs. Prices are shown in your local store, and "Restore purchases" brings everything back on a new phone.

q.zh-CN: AI 功能需要什么？会发什么数据出去？
q.en: What does the AI need, and what does it send?

a.zh-CN: 需要你在 App 里填一个大模型服务商的 API Key，费用由你和服务商结算。请求默认只包含孩子的年龄段和你授权范围内的趋势摘要，例如生长百分位区间、习惯打卡天数、任务完成率；不发姓名、生日、身高体重明细，财商数据默认关闭。每类数据有单独开关，发送前的取数说明卡逐条列出实际注入的内容。
a.en: You enter an API key from a model provider in the app; usage is billed between you and that provider. Requests include only the child's age band and trend summaries within scopes you allow, such as growth percentile ranges, habit check-in days and task completion rates; never names, birthdays or exact measurements, and money data is off by default. Each scope has its own switch, and a card lists every injected item before sending.

a.zh-CN: 它是基于发展心理学研究结论的趋势模拟，不是对某个孩子的精准预测，页面上写明了这一点。六个教养滑块的起点会按你做过的教养方式测评预填，雷达旁的对照点来自你家的真实记录，但那反映的是家长在练什么，不是孩子的性格分数。把它当成一个把抽象教育理念变成可视因果的思考工具。
a.en: It is a trend simulation built on developmental-psychology findings, not a precise prediction for any child, and the page says so. The six sliders start from your own parenting-style quiz, and the reference dots come from your real logs, but those describe what the family practises rather than scoring the child. Treat it as a thinking tool that turns abstract parenting ideas into visible cause and effect.

q.en: How do I move my data to a new phone?

a.zh-CN: 在「我的 → 数据与备份」导出一份备份文件，加密版需要设口令；把文件发到新手机，在新手机的同一页面点「从备份恢复 → 从文件里选」。iOS 上打开 iCloud 私有备份后，同一 Apple ID 的新设备可以直接选「iCloud 里的备份」。导入可选合并或覆盖，合并不会重复建档，覆盖前会自动存快照，24 小时内可撤销。
a.en: Export a backup from "Me → Data & backup" (the encrypted version needs a passphrase), send the file to the new phone and choose "Restore from backup → Choose a file" on the same page there. On iOS with iCloud private backup on, a new device on the same Apple ID can pick "Backup in iCloud" directly. Import offers merge or overwrite; merge never duplicates a child, and a snapshot is taken before overwrite so you can undo within 24 hours.

q.en: What about more than one child?

a.zh-CN: 可以建多个孩子档案，首页和成长页左右甩一下就切换，每个孩子的面板按各自年龄段展开，记录、提醒、报告都分开算。
a.en: You can add several children and switch by flicking left or right on the home and growth pages. Each child's panels follow their own age band, and logs, reminders and reports are kept separately.

q.zh-CN: 它能替代医生或心理咨询吗？
q.en: Does it replace a doctor or counsellor?

a.zh-CN: 不能。健康内容依据国内儿科标准整理，但只是记录与科普参考；生长曲线偏离、疫苗安排、情绪行为问题都请以医生和专业机构的意见为准。App 内相关页面都带有免责声明。
a.en: No. Health content follows Chinese paediatric standards but is a record-keeping and reference aid only; for growth concerns, vaccine schedules or emotional and behavioural issues, follow your doctor and qualified professionals. The relevant screens carry disclaimers.
